# Third-Party Dependencies & Licenses

All computational dependencies are open-source (no commercial solver licenses required):
- **NumPy** (BSD-3-Clause): [licenses/NumPy_LICENSE.txt](licenses/NumPy_LICENSE.txt)
- **SciPy** (BSD-3-Clause): [licenses/SciPy_LICENSE.txt](licenses/SciPy_LICENSE.txt)
- **Matplotlib** (PSF-based): [licenses/Matplotlib_LICENSE.txt](licenses/Matplotlib_LICENSE.txt)
- **CVXPY** (Apache-2.0): [licenses/CVXPY_LICENSE.txt](licenses/CVXPY_LICENSE.txt)
- **Clarabel** (Apache-2.0): Open-source interior-point conic solver ([github.com/oxfordcontrol/Clarabel.rs](https://github.com/oxfordcontrol/Clarabel.rs))
- **USDOT / FHWA NGSIM I-80 Excerpt** (CC BY-SA 3.0 / 4.0, DOI [10.21949/1504477](https://doi.org/10.21949/1504477)): See [data/raw/external/README.md](../data/raw/external/README.md).
